name: agentcheck-monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @agentcheck/core && npm run build --workspace @agentcheck/cli && npm run build --workspace agentcheck-vscode
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @agentcheck/core && npm run test --workspace @agentcheck/cli && npm run test --workspace agentcheck-vscode
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @agentcheck/core && npm run build --workspace @agentcheck/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @agentcheck/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace agentcheck-vscode

description: Deterministic, local-first verification of coding-agent changes before you commit.
author: emreordu
